nodes.name: webglcompressedtextures3tc.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc WebGL extension for S3TC/DXT compressed texture format support with format registration.

nodes.name: extension.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebGLExtension trait and WebGLExtensionSpec enum forming the base interface that all WebGL extension types must implement.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust trait with associated type and five required methods for extension lifecycle management.

nodes.name: extensions.rs
nodes.summary: Central WebGL extension manager providing registration, capability detection, feature state tracking, and bulk registration of all supported extensions.

nodes.name: extensions/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the WebGLExtension trait, WebGLExtensions manager, WebGLExtensionSpec enum, and all extension type implementations.

nodes.name: wrapper.rs
nodes.summary: Generic wrapper types for WebGL extensions providing lazy initialization, identity management, and delegation to concrete extension implementations.

nodes.name: webgl/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Parent module declaring the public submodules of the WebGL DOM implementation including extensions, validations, rendering contexts, and buffer types.

nodes.name: validations/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the WebGLValidator trait for type-safe validation patterns and declares validation submodules for texture image operations.

nodes.name: WEBGLCompressedTextureS3TC
nodes.summary: WebGL extension class for WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc adding S3TC/DXT compressed texture formats (DXT1, DXT3, DXT5) to the implementation.

nodes.name: WebGLExtension
nodes.summary: Trait defining the extension interface with required methods for creation, spec querying, support detection, activation, and name lookup.

nodes.name: WebGLExtensionSpec
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing extensions available in All WebGL versions versus Specific versions for version-gated extension support.

nodes.name: WebGLExtensions
nodes.summary: Central registry managing all WebGL extension instances, tracking supported extensions, and providing feature capability checks across the rendering context.

nodes.name: WebGLExtensionFeatures
nodes.summary: Internal state container tracking all enabled extension capabilities including texture types, parameter names, hint targets, and compression formats.

nodes.name: WebGLExtensionWrapper
nodes.summary: Trait defining the internal wrapper interface for storing WebGL extension instances in a common list and providing lazy initialization.

nodes.name: TypedWebGLExtensionWrapper
nodes.summary: Concrete generic wrapper storing an optional DOM extension instance and implementing the WebGLExtensionWrapper trait via delegation to the typed extension.

nodes.name: WebGLValidator
nodes.summary: Trait defining a type-safe validation pattern with associated output and error types for WebGL operation parameter validation.

nodes.name: enable
nodes.summary: Activates S3TC compressed texture support by registering DXT1, DXT3, and DXT5 compression formats with the WebGL implementation.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new WebGLExtensions manager with the specified WebGL version, API type, and GLSL version for feature gating.

nodes.name: init_once
nodes.summary: One-time initialization that parses GL extension strings, populates the supported extensions set, and registers all known extension types.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a WebGL extension type into the manager's extension map, making it available for deferred initialization.

nodes.name: get_supported_extensions
nodes.summary: Returns the list of extension names that are supported by the current GL context, filtered by WebGL version compatibility.

nodes.name: get_or_init_extension
nodes.summary: Looks up a WebGL extension by name, returning the JS object reference after deferred initialization if supported.

nodes.name: is_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether a specific typed extension has been instantiated and enabled in the current context.

nodes.name: supports_gl_extension
nodes.summary: Checks if a specific GL extension string is present in the supported extensions set.

nodes.name: supports_any_gl_extension
nodes.summary: Checks whether any of the given GL extension strings is supported, used for extensions available under multiple names.

nodes.name: supports_all_gl_extension
nodes.summary: Checks whether all given GL extension strings are supported, used for extensions requiring multiple underlying GL extensions.

nodes.name: enable_tex_type
nodes.summary: Removes a texture data type from the disabled set, enabling its use in texImage2D and texSubImage2D calls.

nodes.name: is_tex_type_enabled
nodes.summary: Queries whether a texture data type is currently enabled (not in the disabled set).

nodes.name: add_effective_tex_internal_format
nodes.summary: Registers a mapping from a source internal format and data type pair to an effective internal format for texture validation.

nodes.name: get_effective_tex_internal_format
nodes.summary: Looks up the effective texel internal format for a given source format and data type pair, falling back to the source format.

nodes.name: enable_filterable_tex_type
nodes.summary: Removes a texture data type from the non-filterable set, enabling linear filtering for that type.

nodes.name: is_filterable
nodes.summary: Checks whether a texture data type supports linear filtering by verifying it is not in the non-filterable set.

nodes.name: enable_hint_target
nodes.summary: Adds a hint target name to the enabled set, making it available for use with glHint.

nodes.name: is_hint_target_enabled
nodes.summary: Queries whether a hint target has been enabled by any extension.

nodes.name: enable_get_parameter_name
nodes.summary: Removes a GL parameter name from the disabled set, making it accessible via glGetParameter.

nodes.name: is_get_parameter_name_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether a GL parameter name is enabled for use with glGetParameter.

nodes.name: enable_get_tex_parameter_name
nodes.summary: Removes a texture parameter name from the disabled set, making it accessible via glGetTexParameter.

nodes.name: is_get_tex_parameter_name_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether a texture parameter name is enabled for use with glGetTexParameter.

nodes.name: enable_get_vertex_attrib_name
nodes.summary: Removes a vertex attribute name from the disabled set, making it accessible via glGetVertexAttrib.

nodes.name: is_get_vertex_attrib_name_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether a vertex attribute name is enabled for use with glGetVertexAttrib.

nodes.name: add_tex_compression_formats
nodes.summary: Registers one or more texture compression formats, adding them to the available compression format list with GL constant mappings.

nodes.name: get_tex_compression_format
nodes.summary: Looks up a TexCompression entry by its GL constant format identifier from the registered compression formats.

nodes.name: get_tex_compression_ids
nodes.summary: Returns all registered compression format GL constant identifiers for enumeration by the WebGL API.

nodes.name: register_all_extensions
nodes.summary: Registers all 16 supported WebGL extension types into the manager during initialization.

nodes.name: enable_element_index_uint
nodes.summary: Enables 32-bit unsigned integer element index support for DrawElements calls.

nodes.name: is_element_index_uint_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether 32-bit unsigned integer element index mode has been enabled.

nodes.name: enable_blend_minmax
nodes.summary: Enables the EXT_blend_minmax blend equation modes (MIN and MAX) for the rendering pipeline.

nodes.name: is_blend_minmax_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks whether min/max blend modes have been enabled by the EXT_blend_minmax extension.

nodes.name: is_float_buffer_renderable
nodes.summary: Checks whether both OES_texture_float and WEBGL_color_buffer_float are enabled for float buffer rendering.

nodes.name: is_min_glsl_version_satisfied
nodes.summary: Checks whether the current GLSL version meets or exceeds the specified minimum version requirement.

nodes.name: is_half_float_buffer_renderable
nodes.summary: Checks whether both OES_texture_half_float and EXT_color_buffer_half_float are enabled for half-float buffer rendering.

nodes.name: effective_type
nodes.summary: Returns the effective OpenGL type for a given type, adjusting for GLES contexts where necessary.

nodes.name: is_gles
nodes.summary: Checks whether the current context is an OpenGL ES (GLES) API type.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TypedWebGLExtensionWrapper with an empty (uninitialized) extension slot.

nodes.name: instance_or_init
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns the JS object reference for a WebGL extension, enabling it on first creation.
